name: aem-eds-personalization
description: Section-based personalization for AEM Edge Delivery Services (DA) pages: Section Metadata rows let rules (geo, device, visitor, URL/UTM param, app state, custom audiences), a decision API, an A/B split or Adobe Target (inline or popup) pick the EDS fragment a section shows, with the authored content as default. Client runtime plus an optional Cloudflare edge worker, a simulator and a Playwright check.
